title: Engineer, Design Verification
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‑generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‑class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‑defining breakthroughs. The company’s footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan’s semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‑solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‑level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader—paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies.

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

 **Job Description**  

* Be a part of end‑to‑end verification execution for SOC owning complex digital IP’s and subsystems from specification to sign‑off
* Define and drive IP‑level verification strategies, including test plans, coverage models, and closure criteria
* Develop scalable, reusable UVM‑based verification environments for IP and subsystem verification
* Lead functional, code, assertion, and cross‑coverage closure, ensuring high‑quality sign‑off with clear metrics
* Apply AI/ML‑assisted verification techniques to accelerate coverage convergence, identify stimulus gaps, and optimize regression efficiency
* Drive constraint random and directed test methodologies for thorough protocol, corner‑case, and stress verification
* Collaborate with RTL, Architecture, Emulation, and SoC Verification teams to ensure seamless IP integration
* Review IP specifications and work with architects to translate requirements into robust verification plans and checkers
* Develop and deploy advanced checkers, scoreboards, assertions (SVA), and protocol monitors
* Work with EDA vendors to evaluate and adopt next‑generation verification, coverage, and analytics tools
* Support Gate‑Level Simulation (GLS), low‑power verification, and post‑silicon debug when required.
* Ensure IP deliverables meet quality, schedule, and reusability expectations for SoC integration.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering
* 1 - 2 years of experience in SoC Verification domains and have working knowledge of industry standard EDA toolkits.
* Strong expertise in UVM‑based testbench architecture and development
* Proven experience in metric‑driven verification, including functional and code coverage closure
* Deep understanding of SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions (SVA), and verification best practices
* Experience with directed and constrained‑random verification methodologies
* Experience debugging complex design issues in simulation, emulation, and post‑silicon environments
* Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, with working knowledge of C/C++, Shell scripting
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills

**Preferred/Plus Qualifications**

Hands‑on experience using AI/ML‑based verification tools for:

* Coverage gap analysis
* Test stimulus optimization
* Regression triage and coverage acceleration
* Scripting expertise in Python, Perl, or TCL for automation and analytics
* Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‑simulation flows
* Familiarity with high‑speed or complex IPs, such as:
* H.264
* Security, debug, or safety‑crititical

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. title: Azure Cloud Engineer (L1/L2 Support & Operations)
description:
**Azure Cloud Engineer (L1/L2 Support & Operations)**

* + **Experience:** 8–10 Years
  + **Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer with 8–10 years of IT infrastructure background, specializing in L1/L2 operations, system administration, infrastructure support, and hands-on Azure workload migrations (required). This role focuses on maintaining 99.9%+ availability targets, resolving incidents, automating routine admin tasks, and executing standard deployments across Azure subscriptions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**First-Line Support & Monitoring**

* + **Incident Management:** Handle incident intake, triage, initial troubleshooting, and ticket resolution for P3/P4 issues; escalate complex P1/P2 incidents to L3/Engineering teams.
  + **Proactive Monitoring:** Perform 24/7 health monitoring using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights; respond promptly to alerts and service health warnings.
  + **Service Desk & Access Requests:** Manage user access requests, Microsoft Entra ID and Azure RBAC role assignments, NSG rule changes, and identity-related support tickets.

**Operational Engineering & Maintenance**

* + **Compute & Storage Admin:** Provision and maintain Azure VMs, Managed Disks, Blob Storage, Azure Files, and VM images; manage snapshots, backups, and storage lifecycle policies.
  + **Azure Migration Delivery (Mandatory):** Execute Azure Migrate discovery and assessment, server replication, test migrations, cutover and rollback activities; support VMware/Hyper-V/on-premises VM migration to Azure, application dependency validation, post-migration troubleshooting, and hypercare.
  + **Database Awareness (Good to Have):** Basic knowledge of Azure SQL Database, SQL Server on Azure VMs, or Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including database connectivity, monitoring, and backup/restore concepts; dedicated DBA expertise is not required.
  + **Networking Maintenance:** Support VNets, subnets, route tables, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure DNS, Private Endpoints, and VPN Gateway connections.
  + **Patching & Compliance:** Schedule and monitor Linux/Windows VM updates using Azure Update Manager; support Azure Policy compliance and remediation tasks.
  + **Basic IaC & Scripting:** Maintain and execute existing Terraform/Bicep templates and PowerShell/Python/Bash scripts for routine automation.
  + **FinOps Execution:** Identify idle VMs, unattached Managed Disks, unused public IPs, and outdated snapshots to optimize monthly Azure spend.

**Core Skill Set**

**Category**

**Technologies / Tools**

**Azure Core Services**

Virtual Machines, Managed Disks, Blob Storage, VNets, Entra ID, Azure DNS, Update Manager, Key Vault

  

**Azure Migration (Required)**

Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery, discovery, readiness, replication, test migration, cutover, rollback, validation, hypercare

  

**Databases (Good to Have)**

Azure SQL Database, SQL Server on Azure VM, Azure Database for PostgreSQL (basic administration, backup/restore concepts and connectivity)

  

**Monitoring & Logging**

Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Activity Log, Application Insights, Grafana

  

**OS & Scripting**

Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu), PowerShell, Bash, Python

  

**IaC & CI/CD**

Terraform/Bicep (Execution & Maintenance), Azure DevOps, GitHub

  

**ITSM & Tools**

ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, PagerDuty

**Qualifications & Certifications**

* + **Experience:** 8–10 years in IT infrastructure/operations, including 5+ years hands-on with Azure and participation in at least one end-to-end Azure migration project (mandatory).
  + **Certifications:** Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) (Required); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (Preferred).
  + **Process Knowledge:** Strong ITIL framework understanding (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).

title: Data Architect / Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**
==========================

We are looking for an experienced **Data Architect / Data Engineer, Assistant Vice President** to provide technical and architectural leadership for enterprise cybersecurity data, analytics, and AI capabilities.

This role will define and deliver scalable **data architectures, Lakehouse platforms, data models, integration frameworks, and AI-ready data foundations** . The individual will partner with cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, governance, risk, and product teams to transform complex security data into scalable, governed, and actionable solutions.

**What you will be responsible for**
====================================

As a Data Architect / Engineer, you will:

* Architect and deliver scalable **Lakehouse and enterprise data platforms** , pipelines, data models, and reusable data products.

* Define **target-state data architecture, reference architectures, integration patterns, standards, and technical roadmaps** .

* Design solutions for large-scale structured, semi-structured, time-series, graph, and unstructured cybersecurity data.

* Establish reusable frameworks for **ETL/ELT, ingestion, orchestration, data quality, metadata, lineage, observability, and reconciliation** .

* Establish architecture standards for **scalability, resiliency, performance, security, privacy, governance, and auditability** .

* Design **AI-ready data architectures** supporting LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, NLP, knowledge graphs, and intelligent workflows.

* Integrate data across **cloud platforms, enterprise systems, cybersecurity platforms, and SIEM/SOAR ecosystems** .

* Provide technical leadership through **architecture reviews, engineering standards, technology evaluation, and solution governance** .

* Partner with stakeholders to translate cybersecurity and business requirements into scalable **data and AI solutions** .

* Mentor engineering teams and drive **reusable architecture patterns, automation, and engineering best practices** .

  

**What we value**
=================

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong expertise in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, and AI/GenAI.

* Deep understanding of Lakehouse architecture, distributed processing, ETL/ELT, data modeling, integration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and governance.

title: Senior Engineer, Design Verification (MCU)
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‑generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‑class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‑defining breakthroughs. The company’s footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan’s semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‑solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‑level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader—paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies.

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

 **Job Description**  

* Be a part of end‑to‑end verification execution for SOC owning complex digital IP’s and subsystems from specification to sign‑off
* Define and drive IP‑level verification strategies, including test plans, coverage models, and closure criteria
* Develop scalable, reusable UVM‑based verification environments for IP and subsystem verification
* Lead functional, code, assertion, and cross‑coverage closure, ensuring high‑quality sign‑off with clear metrics
* Apply AI/ML‑assisted verification techniques to accelerate coverage convergence, identify stimulus gaps, and optimize regression efficiency
* Drive constraint random and directed test methodologies for thorough protocol, corner‑case, and stress verification
* Collaborate with RTL, Architecture, Emulation, and SoC Verification teams to ensure seamless IP integration
* Review IP specifications and work with architects to translate requirements into robust verification plans and checkers
* Develop and deploy advanced checkers, scoreboards, assertions (SVA), and protocol monitors
* Work with EDA vendors to evaluate and adopt next‑generation verification, coverage, and analytics tools
* Mentor junior engineers and promote best‑in‑class verification practices and continuous improvement
* Support Gate‑Level Simulation (GLS), low‑power verification, and post‑silicon debug when required.
* Ensure IP deliverables meet quality, schedule, and reusability expectations for SoC integration.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering.
* 2 - 4 years of experience in SoC Verification domains and working knowledge of industry-standard EDA toolkits.
* Strong expertise in UVM-based testbench architecture and development.
* Proven experience in metric-driven verification, including functional and code coverage closure.
* Deep understanding of SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions (SVA), and verification best practices.
* Experience with directed and constrained-random verification methodologies.
* Experience debugging complex design issues in simulation, emulation, and post-silicon environments.
* Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, with working knowledge of C/C++, and Shell scripting.
* Experience in verification of MCU-based SoCs and subsystems, including CPU cores, AHB/APB/AXI bus protocols, interrupt controllers, GPIO, timers, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, low-power features, and embedded peripherals.
* Strong understanding of MCU architectures such as ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, or equivalent embedded processor architectures.
* Knowledge of firmware-driven verification techniques and embedded software interaction with MCU peripherals is desirable.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred/Plus Qualifications:**

Hands-on experience using AI/ML-based verification tools for:

* Coverage gap analysis
* Test stimulus optimization
* Regression triage and coverage acceleration
* Scripting expertise in Python, Perl, or TCL for automation and analytics.
* Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal-simulation flows.
* Familiarity with high-speed or complex IPs, such as:
* H.264
* Security, debug, or safety-critical IPs
* Experience with MCU functional safety concepts (ISO 26262), low-power verification, secure boot, and embedded system validation is a plus.
* Experience with firmware development/debugging in Embedded C or RTOS-based environments is desirable.

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: Identity Architect
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**  
  
As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
* Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
* Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
* Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
* Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
* Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
* Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
* Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

8 to 12+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments and certificate lifecycle management solutions.  

Strong practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate templates, certificate enrollment, and certificate lifecycle processes.  
Demonstrated hands-on expertise in:  
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) design and administration.  

  Certificate Authorities, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and certificate trust chains.  
  Cryptographic concepts including public/private keys, digital signatures, encryption, hashing algorithms, and key management.  
  Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Azure Key Vault, and cryptographic key protection mechanisms.  
  Certificate-based authentication, TLS/SSL, mutual TLS (mTLS), code signing, and secure communications.
Experience implementing certificate lifecycle management solutions and certificate automation across enterprise environments.  
Experience supporting cloud and hybrid PKI environments integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure services, and enterprise security platforms.  
Strong knowledge of certificate governance, compliance requirements, cryptographic standards, and security best practices.  
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for PKI administration, certificate management, and reporting.  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills within complex enterprise environments.  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, capable of working with technical and non-technical stakeholders .
  

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with DigiCert, Keyfactor, AppViewX, Venafi, Microsoft Cloud PKI, or similar certificate lifecycle management platforms.  

Experience with Microsoft Intune certificate deployment (SCEP/PKCS), Azure Key Vault, HSM technologies, cryptographic key management, and enterprise PKI governance.  
Experience implementing certificate automation, non-human identity (NHI) management, machine identity security, and PKI modernization initiatives.  
Knowledge of Zero Trust, modern identity security, certificate-based authentication, quantum-safe cryptography trends, and cloud security architectures.  
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, AZ-500, AZ-104, or relevant PKI/security certifications; healthcare or other regulated industry experience is a plus.
  

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

**Additional Information**

This position is required to be filled urgently for Content Supply BU. Would request for quick action.

title: Senior HPC Cloud Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You will be the primary architecture reviewer and performance champion for new data center clusters being built across multiple sites globally.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the build-out and day-to-day operation of NVIDIA's VLSI high-performance compute environments in the public cloud, and the repeatable patterns that let us stand up the next environment faster than the last.
* Bring up and operate large compute clusters on Google Cloud end to end - instance provisioning, machine images, OS pipelines, networking, identity and quota management.
* Build the automation that makes cluster bring-up reproducible: infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, image build pipelines, and host lifecycle automation including hostname and identity preservation across maintenance events.
* Extend the same patterns to new on-premises data centers so cloud and on-prem run on one toolchain rather than two, and work with networking and storage teams on cross-site connectivity, latency budgets, and what is cross-mounted versus kept site-local.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will debug at depth when clusters misbehave - image and boot issues, mount failures, scheduler-host interactions, capacity and quota problems - and partner with the scheduling and operations engineers so what you build is operable by the whole team, not only by you.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering, with substantial time running production compute at scale.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with a major public cloud, Google Cloud preferred - compute, networking, IAM, storage, quotas, and the operational realities of running thousands of instances rather than tens.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and configuration management skills (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent), plus experience with machine image build and OS lifecycle pipelines for large fleets.
* Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting: filesystems, NFS mounts and latency, networking, boot and image pipelines.
* Working understanding of data center and network fundamentals for compute-intensive workloads - topology, bandwidth and latency characterisation, and the practical limits of cross-site operation - along with familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and how compute nodes join, leave and are managed within them.
* Strong Python automation, experience bringing a new environment, cluster or data center online end to end, and the ability to work effectively across time zones. Semiconductor/EDA exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Software Engineering Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team:**  
Cisco is transforming its platforms to run the next generation of cloud-native and multi-cloud services. This team builds tools and platforms that enable engineers to procure, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure at scale across hybrid environments. While we work closely with infrastructure and platform operations, solving complex problems through software engineering is at our core. This role offers the opportunity to operate as a senior technical leader for software and AI-first platform transformation.
  
  
**Your Impact:**  
You are a senior software engineer with deep technical breadth across architecture, software development, and operations. You lead through both execution and influence, shaping technical direction while enabling teams to deliver high-impact outcomes. You have substantial experience applying AI and machine learning to enterprise software and platform operations and can guide adoption patterns that are scalable, secure, and measurable.
  
  
As a Software Engineer, you will lead strategic platform automation and user-facing capabilities that improve reliability, scalability, and developer experience across Cisco IT cloud services. This role includes leading AI-enabled capabilities, including assistant or agent-driven workflows, intent-based interactions, and ML-enabled operational intelligence. You will drive major initiatives from concept through operation, partnering across product, platform, and engineering organizations.
  
  

* Lead development of complex software capabilities that improve cloud platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency in a DevOps model.
* Define and implement AI-enabled platform patterns that improve user journeys and operational outcomes across services.
* Architect and guide implementation of cloud-native microservices and APIs in Kubernetes-based environments.
* Drive cross-organizational technical planning, architecture alignment, and delivery execution.
* Apply LLM/ML frameworks (for example LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) to enterprise-scale production use cases.
* Lead improvements in observability, resiliency engineering, and automation strategy.
* Establish high standards for CI/CD, code quality, release reliability, and secure engineering practices.
* Lead production-readiness, incident learning, and long-term reliability programs.
* Mentor and develop engineers, and provide technical leadership across multiple teams.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors + 12 years of related experience, or Masters + 8 years of related experience, or PhD + 5 years of related experience.
* 10+ years of software development experience with Python and/or Go in enterprise cloud environments.
* Deep experience in cloud-native architecture, APIs, microservices, and platform automation.
* Advanced experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and DevOps/SRE-aligned operating models.
* Proven experience delivering AI/ML-enabled capabilities in production and scaling adoption across organizations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong experience with SQL and NoSQL data platforms and distributed systems concerns.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience defining AI strategy and implementation standards for platform engineering organizations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud platforms and enterprise-scale infrastructure services.
* Deep expertise in observability, reliability engineering, and operational excellence practices.

* Strong track record of mentorship, talent development, and technical community leadership.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**  
  
As a Principal Consultant (Delivery Enterprise Architect) within the Dell organization, aligned to Consulting Service Delivery, you will provide consultative business and technical delivery services for a range of complex customer-facing consulting engagements, in partnership with Global Pre-Sales, Account Management and Solutioning Teams. Specifically, you will be part of projects deploying, administering and configurating Large Language Model and Generative AI software stacks. These projects will focus on allowing Dell customers to deploy and fine-tune GenAI models.  
  
Also, as the senior-most technical member of the Services Delivery team, for the GenAI/Data Science Practice, you will work alongside other Dell badged Consultants, to earn the customers trust through competence, technical acumen, consulting expertise, and partnership. You would also be responsible for providing guidance/oversight to these individuals and technical grooming activities for their skill upgrading. This position requires a dynamic individual with expert customer-facing skills, leadership qualities and forecasting abilities for a particular technology and its lifecycle. The ability to guide customers and communicate technical processes and ideas is essential. These engagements often ensure that the customer is also enabled in the technologies being delivered.  
  
The person should have the common traits and capabilities that are listed in Section 2 (Essential Requirements) and meet many of the capabilities listed in Section 3 (Desirable Requirements).  
  
**Key Requirements:**  
  
**Experience and qualifications:**  
  

* 18+ years in the IT industry, preferably with a masters degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* 8+ years in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data within a customer-facing services delivery role, including the ability to engage Data Scientists and assess their current and future ecosystems.
* 5+ years implementing and supporting infrastructure deployment, setup, and configuration through automation (agentic automation a strong plus).

  
**Generative & Agentic AI:**  
  

* Deep, hands-on knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the broader Generative AI tooling ecosystem.
* Proven experience designing agentic AI solutions and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, Langfuse, and LangSmith.
* Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI software suite, including NVIDIA Base Command Manager (formerly Bright Cluster Manager), the NeMo framework, and Triton Inference Server.

  
**MLOps & AIOps Platforms:**  
  

* Deep understanding of the MLOps and AIOps ecosystem, with hands-on experience across platforms such as Kubeflow, MLflow, Run:ai, ClearML, Ray, H2O, and Cohere.

  
**Data Engineering & Distributed Systems:**  
  

* Extensive production experience with distributed query and processing engines Kafka, Trino (Starburst) and Apache Spark.
* Hands-on experience with modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) for managing large-scale datasets.
* Mastery of cloud-native storage and compute e.g., AWS S3/EMR, GCP BigQuery/Dataproc, or Azure ADLS/Databricks.
* Deep understanding of columnar storage formats (Parquet, Avro) and how to optimize them for different query patterns.

  
**DevOps, IaC & CI/CD:**  
  

* Proven application of DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across both application development and infrastructure automation including desired-state configuration, GitOps, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Extensive experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab, Argo CD, and Tekton.

  
**Kubernetes & Containers:**  
  

* Proven experience deploying and configuring Kubernetes (e.g., OpenShift), with deep knowledge of application deployments, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
* Extensive experience building containerized applications, including container image signing.
* Knowledge of AI-related Kubernetes operators, such as the NVIDIA GPU, Network, and Storage operators.

  
**Consulting & Delivery Skills:**  
  

* Ability to earn customer trust and to plan, organize, and lead customer workshops; excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Comfortable working in efficient Agile teams (Scrum or Kanban), including extended pairing and enablement sessions that drive knowledge transfer in complex domains.
* Ability to influence and interact with confidence and credibility at all levels within Dell and across customers, partners, and vendors.
* Experience delivering within a defined project methodology while adhering to SOW, margin, and planning requirements.
* Willingness and ability to be onsite for customer workshops and enablement sessions.

title: AI Technical Lead 1
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

DADAI (Data, Analytics, Digital & AI Delivery) is building a next generation enterprise delivery engine that turns the company’s biggest opportunities into measurable outcomes using data products, digital automation and applied AI. The ambition is to combine startup pace with enterprise discipline: product thinking, predictable delivery at scale, strong engineering standards, and clear architecture, security and quality gates that enable speed without compromising control. DADAI has been shaped as an enterprise “factory”, 200+ engineers, designed to absorb significant demand across multiple global domains, industrializing the path from idea to production and continuous improvement while scaling through strategic partners and still preserving internal knowledge and ownership. This is a rare opportunity to join a new leadership organization and to help set how the Teva will use data, analytics and AI to modernize decision making, automate critical processes, and accelerate innovation across core functions and value chains.

The AI Technical Lead owns the technical delivery of production-grade AI systems across enterprise digital, data, and analytics environments. This role sets engineering direction and provides strong hands-on leadership to design, build, deploy, and operate enterprise AI capabilities on a Microsoft-first stack, including agentic systems, generative AI applications, AI-enabled automation, and ML-powered platforms, ensuring consistent standards, quality, governance, security, and reliable global operations.Partners with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, legal, and central AI/data governance teams to enable delivery teams (internal and external partners) to build scalable, compliant, and auditable AI solutions across regions, cloud environments, and delivery models.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

* Accountable for all AI engineering activities with in the DADAI delivery factory.
* Lead the design, build, and operation of enterprise AI solutions on a Microsoft-first stack, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, and Azure services.
* Remain highly hands-on: review architecture and code, build proofs of concept, troubleshoot complex issues, and guide implementation teams through production hardening.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for AI delivery, including evaluation, monitoring, release controls, security, privacy, and Responsible AI practices in regulated environments.
* Work across architects, platform teams, security, and delivery stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are scalable, supportable, compliant, and aligned to business needs.

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* 7+ years of proven experience leading and developing large (20+) engineering teams, including direct people management responsibilities, coaching, performance management, career development, and hiring in a complex enterprise environment.
* 10+ years in software engineering, including senior hands-on design and delivery of applications and API in a modern Microsoft cloud environment.
* 2+ delivering complex enterprise production GenAI and agentic solutions on Microsoft technologies such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, RAG, and evaluation workflows.
* Strong Azure engineering background, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, API Management, Entra, CI/CD, monitoring, and production support.
* 10+ years Hands-on technical leadership with proven ability to build POCs, MVPs and production applications, review code and architecture, troubleshoot production issues, and lead implementation teams by example.
* 5+ years of experience working in enterprise or regulated environments with strong security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI controls.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across architecture, security, delivery, and business teams.
* BSc/BA in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience; relevant Azure or AI certifications are a plus.

**Key Skills**
--------------

* Hands-on builder and technical leader who can design, prototype, review, and unblock complex AI implementations.
* Strong problem-solving across prompts, models, retrieval, orchestration, runtime behavior, performance, and cost.
* Ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions, delivery plans, and engineering trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of AI SDLC, evaluation, monitoring, rollback, and operational readiness for production systems.
* Clear communication and strong collaboration in cross-functional, global delivery environments.

**Core Technology Stack**
-------------------------

* **AI platforms**: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow
* **Azure engineering**: Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, API Management, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus
* **Engineering and SDLC:** Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, Azure Machine Learning, CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, observability
* **Security and governance**: Microsoft Entra, Purview, Key Vault, Defender, Azure Policy
* **Data and analytics**: Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, SQL

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.

Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. title: Data & AI Architect
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Data & AI Architect to define and govern the target architecture for Advanced Analytics, AI, and Data Products across SVD TEC. As the Data & AI Architect, you will ensure that analytics and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, secure, reusable, and governed foundation rather than isolated project-specific solutions.

You will define architecture standards, integration patterns, data contracts, AI deployment approaches, and governance models that enable teams to consistently deliver analytics and AI capabilities across products such as EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, condition monitoring, and predictive maintenance. You will act as the technical authority connecting business needs, product strategy, data platforms, AI services, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and product teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the target Data & AI Architecture for SVD TEC.
* Establish standards for data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, AI, and interoperability.
* Design reusable architecture building blocks and reference patterns.
* Define architecture principles for Data Products, Data Governance, Data Quality, Analytics Platforms, MLOps, AI Platforms, Agent Architectures, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Integration Services.
* Drive architectural alignment across SDA, EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, and future initiatives.
* Define integration approaches between internal platforms, customer environments, industrial systems, cloud services, and AI capabilities.
* Establish data contracts, API standards, interoperability guidelines, and reusable integration patterns.
* Participate in technology evaluations and partner assessments.
* Review and approve architectural decisions for major AI and analytics initiatives.
* Support cybersecurity, compliance, and governance reviews.
* Define transition strategies from PoC to MVP to production.
* Coach engineers and project teams on architecture best practices.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and architectural debt early.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

* Strong experience as Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, Data Architect, Analytics Architect, or AI Architect.
* Deep understanding of modern data architectures and analytics platforms.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of Data Lakehouse architectures, Data Warehousing, Data Mesh, Data Products, Data Governance, Metadata, Data Catalogs, Event-driven architectures, API architectures, and Cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with AI deployment architectures, MLOps, and operationalization of models.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience balancing long-term architecture goals with delivery realities.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills & Attributes:**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Foundry, Fabric, Cognite Data Fusion, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial data platforms, time-series data, asset models, historian systems, and IoT architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Layers, GraphRAG, Agentic AI Architectures, Multi-Agent Systems, Vector Databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, identity management, confidential data handling, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent systems thinking and ability to identify architectural dependencies across products and teams.
* Pragmatic mindset that prioritizes business value while maintaining architectural integrity.

Join the Advanced Analytics team responsible for establishing the long-term Data & AI foundation across SVD TEC. This role will shape how analytics, AI, digital products, and industrial data platforms evolve over the coming years. You will ensure that innovations in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, AI assistants, analytics products, and agentic AI are built on a common architecture that is scalable, maintainable, secure, and reusable across the portfolio.

title: Platform Architect
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Platform Architect** to define and drive the architecture of a modern, cloud-native platform supporting scalable, secure, and resilient applications.

The role requires strong expertise in **containerization, microservices, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Redis, multi-tenant architecture, and cross-region deployment**. Microsoft Azure experience is preferred.

The Platform Architect will work closely with engineering, DevOps/SRE, security, and product teams to establish platform standards, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture and technical direction for the platform.
* Design scalable and resilient **microservices-based architectures**.
* Establish standards for containerized workloads and Kubernetes deployments.
* Define cloud architecture using Azure services and cloud-native design principles.
* Design secure and scalable **multi-tenant architectures**, including tenant isolation and resource segregation.
* Define **multi-region deployment**, failover, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies.
* Design caching and distributed state-management solutions using **Redis**.
* Establish standards for service communication, API design, asynchronous messaging, retries, resiliency, and fault handling.
* Define platform security patterns including identity, access control, secrets management, and workload isolation.
* Define observability standards for logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health.
* Guide Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automated platform deployment practices.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and drive resolution of architectural risks and technical debt.
* Create and maintain reference architectures, design documentation, and architecture decisions.
* Mentor engineering teams on cloud-native and distributed-system design practices.

**Core Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

**Containerization**

* Strong experience with Docker/OCI containers.
* Understanding of container lifecycle, security, networking, and image optimization.

**Kubernetes**

* Strong hands-on architectural knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Experience with:
* Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and Ingress
* ConfigMaps and Secrets
* Autoscaling and resource management
* Persistent storage
* RBAC and network policies
* Cluster and workload high availability
* Experience with **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)** preferred.

**Microservices & Distributed Systems**

* Strong understanding of:
* REST APIs and service-to-service communication
* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures
* API gateways
* Service decomposition
* Resiliency patterns
* Distributed transactions
* Eventual consistency
* Idempotency
* Fault tolerance and graceful degradation

**Cloud Architecture**

* Strong cloud architecture experience, preferably with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Familiarity with relevant Azure services such as:
* AKS
* Azure Container Registry
* Azure Front Door / Application Gateway
* Virtual Networks and Private Link
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Managed Identities
* Key Vault
* Azure Monitor / Application Insights
* Azure Storage
* Azure SQL or equivalent databases
* Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs
* Azure Managed Redis

**Redis**

* Experience designing Redis for:
* Distributed caching
* Session or transient state
* High availability
* Replication and clustering
* Cache invalidation
* Performance optimization

**Multi-Tenant Architecture**

* Experience designing SaaS or shared platforms with:
* Tenant isolation
* Identity and authorization boundaries
* Data and resource segregation
* Tenant provisioning
* Noisy-neighbor mitigation
* Tenant-level monitoring and configuration

**Multi-Region Architecture**

* Experience designing:
* Regional deployment patterns
* Active-active and active-passive architectures
* Traffic routing
* Disaster recovery
* Regional failover
* Data replication
* RTO/RPO strategies

**Preferred Skills**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Helm and GitOps
* Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs
* OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana
* API Management and service mesh
* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Zero-trust and cloud security
* SRE and reliability engineering practices

**Experience**

* Typically **10+ years of software or platform engineering experience**.
* At least **4–6 years of experience in cloud-native and distributed-system architecture**.
* Proven experience architecting production platforms using Kubernetes and microservices.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient systems.

**Key Architecture Competencies**

The candidate should be able to evaluate architectural trade-offs such as:

* Shared vs dedicated tenant infrastructure
* Shared Kubernetes clusters vs tenant-specific clusters
* Database-per-tenant vs shared database models
* Stateless vs stateful services
* Synchronous APIs vs asynchronous messaging
* Active-active vs active-passive regional deployments
* Managed cloud services vs self-managed components
* Security and isolation vs infrastructure cost

title: Sr. Security Specialist
description:
### **About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?

### 

### **About the role**

As a **Senior Associate – Security Architecture, Design & Proof of Value**, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be part of the Cybersecurity Architecture & Risk organization, supporting the architecture, design, assessment, and validation of security technology solutions.

You will combine security architecture consulting with hands-on participation in Proof of Concept (POC) and Proof of Value (POV) activities. Working with Senior Managers, security architects, enterprise architects, engineering teams, and technology vendors, you will translate security requirements into practical designs, validate security controls, assess emerging technologies, and develop evidence-based recommendations.

### 

### **In this role, you will:**

* Support security architecture and solution-design reviews across cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, identity, network, and AI domains. Translate business and technology requirements into security requirements, architecture patterns, control recommendations, and practical solution designs.
* Participate in architecture assurance, threat modelling, and design reviews to identify security gaps, dependencies, risks, potential attack paths, and recommended remediation. Assess controls covering IAM, privileged access, workload/service identities, segmentation, encryption, secrets, logging, monitoring, and data protection.
* Plan and execute cybersecurity POCs/POVs by defining use cases, scope, success criteria, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, required integrations, data flows, identities, connectivity, and security controls.
* Perform hands-on configuration, integration, and testing of security technologies in approved POC/POV environments. Validate vendor capabilities against requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, collect objective evidence, and document gaps, limitations, dependencies, risks, and recommendations.
* Develop architecture and data-flow diagrams, security-control mappings, test cases, technical assessments, reusable security architecture patterns, assessment checklists, and POC/POV documentation. Contribute to final reports and leadership presentations and provide status updates on technical issues, dependencies, actions, and risks.

Embrace Cognizant’s culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build relationships.

### 

### **What you must have to be considered**

* **6–9 years of experience in information/cybersecurity**, with practical exposure to security architecture, solution design, security engineering, or consulting.
* Hands-on experience participating in and delivering cybersecurity POCs/POVs, technology evaluations, or pilots.
* Good understanding of enterprise security architecture principles and secure-by-design practices.
* Practical knowledge across multiple security domains such as IAM, cloud security, network security, application/API security, data security, or security operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, data flows, APIs, and technology integration patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to technical detail.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical security concepts.
* A strong sense of ownership and commitment to creating meaningful outcomes, consistent with the corporate template’s required attributes.

### 

### **These will help you succeed**

* Experience supporting cloud and hybrid security assessments.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, privileged access, and workload/service identity security.
* Understanding of network security, segmentation, and Zero Trust principles.
* Knowledge of application/API security, data security, encryption, DLP, security monitoring, and logging.
* Experience with third-party technology and security assessments.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI security assessments, including identity, data protection, model/API security, agent/tool security, and governance controls.
* Experience with threat modelling, security-control validation, architecture assurance, and design reviews.
* Ability to develop clear technical assessments and evidence-based recommendations for senior stakeholders.

### 

### **Work model**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a **hybrid position open to qualified applicants anywhere in India**.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on the project as well as business and client requirements.

title: Products & Solutions Development Team Leader
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Engineering Manager – Digital Backbone**

**Role purpose:** Build the teams, engineering system, and leadership capability that turn Digital Backbone into the reusable, trusted foundation for Siemens Healthineers’ next generations of connected, cloud-ready, AI-enabled healthcare products. The role combines people leadership, product-minded engineering management, and cross-organization influence to convert platform strategy into measurable customer, business, and engineering outcomes.

**What Digital Backbone Is**

Digital Backbone is the common digital and engineering foundation that connects products, services, data, devices, and clinical workflows across Digital & Automation. It provides reusable platform capabilities for cloud, edge, and on-premises deployments so business lines can innovate faster without repeatedly rebuilding infrastructure, integration, deployment, data, fleet, licensing, observability, and workflow capabilities. Its value is not measured only by platform delivery, but by the speed, quality, reuse, interoperability, and new business outcomes it enables across the Siemens Healthineers ecosystem.

**What Digital Backbone Must Enable in the Coming Years**

* **One engineering foundation across deployment models:** enable containerized components and consistent development, integration, release, and operation across cloud, edge, and on-premises environments.
* **Reusable platform products at enterprise scale:** shift from local solutions to governed capabilities that multiple business lines can discover, adopt, integrate, and evolve.
* **Connected and interoperable healthcare ecosystems:** strengthen common services for clinical information exchange, workflow orchestration, fleet and device connectivity, deployment, data, analytics, licensing, and business operations.
* **AI-ready and AI-native healthcare engineering:** provide safe, auditable foundations for AI-enabled workflows while embedding responsible AI into the software lifecycle, engineering knowledge, quality, and productivity.
* **Faster customer value and new business models:** shorten time-to-market, decouple software development from delivery, expand fleet-wide services, and enable subscription, metering, marketplace, and data-driven offerings.
* **Operational trust at scale:** make reliability, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory evidence, observability, supportability, and lifecycle sustainability intrinsic platform qualities.
* **A product-oriented global operating model:** create clear end-to-end ownership, transparent priorities, strong domain leadership, and accountable collaboration across product, engineering, architecture, quality, and business stakeholders.

**Engineering Manager Mission**

Create an environment in which autonomous, inclusive, high-performing teams deliver dependable platform products and continuously increase their impact across Digital & Automation. The Engineering Manager owns the health and capability of the engineering organization: the right people, skills, ways of working, quality discipline, delivery system, and partnerships needed to scale Digital Backbone outcomes.

**Core Accountabilities**

* **Translate strategy into team outcomes:** connect Siemens Healthineers, Digital & Automation, BTT, platform, and product priorities to clear team objectives, roadmaps, technical investments, and measurable outcomes.
* **Own organizational capability:** build balanced teams, identify future skill needs, develop succession, grow technical and people leaders, and enable mobility across products, domains, and geographies.
* **Lead predictable value delivery:** establish outcome-based planning, dependency and risk management, transparent flow metrics, and effective collaboration across teams without reducing agility to ceremony compliance.
* **Drive engineering excellence:** improve architecture realization, software craftsmanship, automation, CI/CD, test strategy, cybersecurity, reliability, observability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost.
* **Scale platform adoption and reuse:** treat internal consumers as customers, reduce onboarding friction, actively manage feedback, avoid duplicate solutions, and make reusable capabilities the preferred path.
* **Lead responsible AI transformation:** model effective AI use, establish human validation and governance, develop AI-native skills, and convert successful experiments into reusable engineering practices and product value.
* **Manage end-to-end ownership:** ensure teams understand and own build, release, operation, support, quality, and improvement of their platform products throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape cross-functional decisions:** partner with Product Managers, Architects, System Engineers, Quality, Cybersecurity, Operations, and business lines to resolve trade-offs and align investment with enterprise value.
* **Build a trusted culture:** create psychological safety, high standards, inclusion, accountability, candid feedback, and space for experimentation and learning. Promote and protect Peakon participation and leverage it as strategic tool for employee engagement.
* **Represent engineering:** communicate progress, risks, options, and impact in business language; influence priorities and secure the decisions, funding, and staffing needed for sustainable outcomes.

**Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships**

The Engineering Manager is accountable for people, engineering capability, delivery health, and the environment in which technical decisions are executed. Product Managers own product value, priorities, and market outcomes; Architects own architectural direction and integrity; technical leaders guide implementation and engineering practices. The Engineering Manager connects these accountabilities, makes ownership explicit, removes systemic barriers, and ensures decisions become dependable outcomes rather than parallel plans.

**Measures of Success**

* **Accountability:** the degree to which the engineering manager can create accountability amongst developers and team leadership acting as the anchor for stability and transparency.
* **Customer and ecosystem impact:** adoption, active consumers, integration lead time, reuse, customer outcomes, and satisfaction of internal and external partners.
* **Delivery performance:** predictable commitments, shorter lead time, improved flow, controlled dependencies, and faster recovery from issues.
* **Engineering quality:** automation, defect escape rate, reliability, security posture, observability, maintainability, and reduced technical debt or lifecycle cost.
* **AI and modernization impact:** measured productivity and quality gains, reusable AI-enabled workflows, responsible adoption, and migration from legacy approaches.
* **People and capability:** critical-skill coverage, internal growth, leadership pipeline, engagement, inclusion, retention, and evidence-based development.
* **Business contribution:** avoided duplication, lower cost to serve, faster time-to-market, platform-enabled revenue opportunities, and progress against strategic targets.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

This is an opportunity to shape how future healthcare software is built and delivered—not only to manage an existing team. The Engineering Manager will help create the foundation on which connected devices, interoperable clinical workflows, AI-enabled solutions, fleet services, and future software-defined products can scale. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at **www.ust.com**.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and engineering intelligent applications while leveraging AI-assisted development methodologies. This role requires hands-on experience in full-stack development, modern frontend frameworks, enterprise integrations, and AI-powered solution engineering.

**The Opportunity**

As an AI Engineer, you will play a key role in building innovative AI-enabled applications and enterprise solutions. You will work closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and development teams to design scalable technical solutions, accelerate software development using AI tools, and deliver high-quality products that drive business value.
